errors.text: The milling speed and SPS heating rate conflict with the target conditions: 300 rpm versus 400 rpm and 100°C/min versus 50°C/min.

Low-load Vickers load dependence cannot by itself isolate grain-boundary strengthening from precipitation hardening; indentation-size effects and microstructural heterogeneity provide alternative causes.
The cited evidence concerns refractory HEA systems rather than CoCrFeNiTi and does not substantiate the proposed BCC-to-FCC transition or suppression of Ti-driven HCP precipitation.
